static_guards.description: Any production TypeScript file that calls/imports the known crop-stage resolvers must be registered before merge.
Use/definition of the known irrigation deficit/requirement skills is an explicit semantic touchpoint.
Known Stage-1/Evidence-Judge production qualification entrypoints, including the B-04e canonical sufficiency wrapper, may not silently proliferate.
The current Agronomy Agent direct plan producer is grandfathered at exactly one path; copies are forbidden.
The known DEFAULT_SOIL_MOISTURE compatibility fallback is grandfathered only in the existing Agronomy Agent.
decision_engine_v1 must not become the direct landing zone for future ADR/LLM/MCFT implementation imports.
The two legacy Operator scenario-to-recommendation POST routes and their registration must remain explicitly inventoried; no copy may silently appear.
The currently orphaned evaluateIrrigationDecisionV1 export is registered as debt; new references must first change connectivity classification.
Production module/domain/job roots must not import or require Flight Table/devtools implementation.
Every production route that calls appendRawSampleV1 must be explicitly registered as a raw-observation ingress producer.
Only the explicitly registered B-04 canonical projection may instantiate EvidenceQualificationV1 directly from runtime evidence.
B-05a freezes ContextAssertionV1/ContextSnapshotV1 as contracts only; any production instantiation must be explicitly registered in a later B-05 phase.

B-05c/B-05d permit only explicitly registered QualifiedCropStageStateV1 compatibility projection paths; runtime authority/consumers require explicit later registration and B-09 authority-removal discipline.
Direct CropSkill.resolveStage production touchpoints are frozen: legacy rule_engine is grandfathered and B-05d adapter is capability-only; new unregistered direct skill-stage calls are forbidden.
B-06b permits exactly the registered irrigation CalculationResult compatibility adapter; any additional production instantiation requires explicit later B-06 registration.

B-06g permits exactly the registered B-06c recommendation, B-06d decision-plan, B-06e prescription, B-06f operation-plan candidate-view, and B-06g AgronomyRecommendationV2 adapters; any additional CandidateDecision instantiation requires explicit later registration.

B-07d permits exactly the registered deterministic Decision Eligibility evaluator to instantiate DecisionEligibilityDecisionV1; any additional final eligibility producer requires explicit later registration.

B-07c permits exactly the registered Stage-1 and Agronomy Judge precursor adapters to instantiate canonical eligibility criterion assessments; final DecisionEligibilityDecisionV1 producer remains separately guarded and empty.
B-07e permits exactly the registered Decision Eligibility runtime seam to import/use the B-07d final evaluator; any additional runtime consumer requires explicit later registration.
B-08a freezes DecisionEpisodeV1 but permits zero production assemblers; later B-08 assembler registration must be explicit.

connectivity_model.purpose: Separate capability registration from proven current runtime wiring. B-02 maps both semantic ownership and runtime connectivity without changing runtime behavior.
connectivity_model.registered_consumer_definition: Contract/API/code capable of consuming this semantic. Capability does not prove current runtime wiring.
connectivity_model.runtime_consumer_definition: Repository evidence proves the current runtime wires the producer/output into this consumer. A persisted-data edge, direct call, module registration, route registration, or explicit same-request side effect may qualify when evidence is named.
connectivity_model.invariant: CAN_CONSUME must never be represented as IS_WIRED without a current_connectivity_edge carrying repository evidence.
connectivity_model.scope_note: unknown_unclassified_production_edge=0 means zero unknown edges within the explicit B-02 static/runtime-connectivity audit scope; the linter does not infer arbitrary TypeScript business semantics.
